terra.problem: Saying the drawer was less comfortable compares his experience with the Israelites' comfort, which the text does not describe.
The text says they stayed until they were healed; it does not say healing was the whole reason for their wait.
“That name stuck for good” goes beyond the text, which says the place was called Gilgal to the writer's day.
Calling Bethel a place relies on a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
Calling Shiloh a place relies on a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
“Just” and “a good week” add timing the passage does not give.
Calling the Sabbath a day of rest is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
Calling Purim a feast is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
Saying he would have asked about dessert places Papa Dorin in the Bible event.
The passage does not say Israel was waiting to see this change.
